jobs.title: Data Quality Analyst (AI Model Data Analyst)
jobs.description: Data Quality Analyst (AI Model Data Analyst)  Job Type: Full-time, Permanent Location: Portugal (1-2 days in office per week) Travel: Occasional international travel may be required. Salary: €16,000–€20,000 per annum Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick-and-mortar retail using deep-learning computer vision. Focal has been deployed at scale with the top retailers in the world. We are looking for smart, creative, and passionate people who love to learn, enjoy thinking critically, share our values, and want to build a great and enduring company. We have built the next-generation operating system for brick & mortar retail. This OS leverages shelf-mounted cameras that constantly measure the state of the retailers’ shelves and use that information to order quicker and smarter, planogram better, and schedule, direct, train, and manage their staff. We have proven this with major retailers around the world. Job Description The quality of our computer-vision models depends entirely on the quality of the data they learn from. We are seeking a dedicated Data Quality Analyst to clean, review, and curate the training data that powers our systems. In this role you will assume accountability for the accuracy and consistency of our datasets, directly improving how well our models detect products. Meticulous attention to detail, strong data-handling skills, and the ability to meet quality and speed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are essential. What You Will Be Doing Review, clean, and correct labelled image and product data used to train our computer-vision models. Identify and fix mislabelled, inconsistent, or low-quality data, and flag systematic errors in the labelling pipeline. Conduct routine quality-assurance checks to catch data issues before they reach model training. Onboard and scan products into the system, ensuring catalogue and reference data are accurate and complete. Compare model predictions against ground truth to surface edge cases and areas where the model underperforms. Work collaboratively with the machine-learning and operations teams to improve labelling guidelines and data standards.  Meet or exceed speed and quality Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) consistently. Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members, providing updates on progress and raising any issues or challenges encountered. Requirements:  Strong attention to detail and a genuine care for data accuracy and consistency. Comfort working with large volumes of data, spreadsheets, and data-review or annotation tools Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to spot patterns and root-cause data errors. An interest in or exposure to machine learning, computer vision, or AI data pipelines is advantageous but not essential. Time Management: ability to work well under pressure, meet deadlines, and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks. Communication Skills: effective communication to liaise with supervisors, team members, and the ML team, providing updates and raising issues. Ability to work independently and stay focused on repetitive, detail-heavy tasks for extended periods. Why Focal Systems Strong Values and Mission — We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception. Exceptional Team — We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art. Outstanding Partners — We work with 10+ of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors. What we offer We care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:     Paid Time Off Pension Sick Leave

You are a self-starter who thrives on ownership. You think in pipelines and projections, you obsess over correctness, and you lead a small senior team without ever leaving the code behind. What You Will Do You will lead a small, senior data/reporting team and stay hands-on in the pipeline yourself. You'll set the bar for what "accurate" means at Focal and own the system that turns billions of raw store signals into numbers customers trust. Additionally, you will Own the accuracy and reliability of customer-facing reporting — imports, processing pipelines, reports, dashboards, and exports Build and lead the data platform: Snowflake CDC pipelines, DBT transformations, and silver/gold data layers served through clean APIs Engineer the tooling that keeps data honest — gold-set reconciliation, drift detection, and point-in-time state reconstruction across the entire system Own compute and cost: right-size pipelines (tiered compute for regional vs. chain-wide jobs) and tune queries for speed and price Set the technical bar for the team — plan, review, mentor, and own the outcome end to end Partner with backend, analytics, and customer-facing teams so reporting stays consistent on every surface a customer sees What You Need To Be Successful Bachelor's in CS, EE, or equivalent practical experience 7+ years of professional software/data engineering experience, including ownership of production data systems Strong Python skills, with strong performance-oriented leg Advanced SQL, including query-plan reading, index/optimization work on large tables Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse (Snowflake or equivalent) and transformation frameworks (DBT or similar) Experience with CDC / streaming pipelines and data-intensive applications A track record of owning data correctness in production — reconciliation, validation, and chasing down drift Range across the stack: data, infrastructure, and enough backend to ship end to end Experience with CI/CD tools, Docker, and cloud deployments a plus Compute/cost optimization, warehouse performance tuning, or BI/embedded analytics (Sigma or similar) a plus Technical leadership experience — you raise the bar for the engineers around you and don't wait to be told what to own Startup mentality, team player Fluent in Polish with advanced English skills (written & spoken) Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting to non-technical stakeholders Flexibility in adjusting working hours to meet the needs of the global and time zone-diverse team (urgent tasks or meetings may occur outside of regular CEST working hours) Strong work ethic — drives projects to completion and holds the team to its commitments Why Focal Systems Strong Values and Mission — We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception. You're building a system accurate enough that head offices trust it over their own numbers, with the autonomy to make the calls and see your work shape how the world's biggest retailers operate. Placement within range is equally determined by education, general experience in your profession, specific experience in our domain, and your performance in the talent acquisition process. It is rare to receive an offer at the top of the range for a role.

jobs.description: Type: Fixed-term contract (6 months), 40 hours per week Work Location: On the road and at customer sites in the Leeds area. Pay:   £17 per hour Licence/Certification: Full valid UK driving licence (required) Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. Job Description We are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Field Data Collector to support our operations throughout London and the South on a fixed-term basis. This role is responsible for visiting sites to accurately capture, record, and report data in line with company standards and timelines. Reporting to the Senior Operations Manager, the ideal candidate is organised, comfortable working independently in the field, and confident using mobile devices or apps to log information accurately. This will be a 6 Month contract position, working 40 hrs per week with a possibility to extend beyond the initial contract. Driver's License and Transportation: Valid driver's license and reliable transportation to travel to sites is required.   What You Will Be Doing Travel to designated sites to collect, measure, and record data accurately and in a timely manner. Use company systems, apps, or devices to log data in real time or shortly after each visit. Follow standardised data collection procedures to ensure consistency and accuracy across all sites. Report any site access issues, discrepancies, or anomalies to the Senior Operations Manager promptly. Maintain accurate records of site visits, mileage, and time spent on each task. Communicate effectively with site contacts, customers, or the public where required. Adhere to health and safety procedures and company policies while working in the field. Ensure all equipment used for data collection is maintained, charged, and in good working order. Meet daily/weekly targets for the number of site visits or data points collected. Provide regular updates and progress reports to the Senior Operations Manager. Escalate any quality, access, or safety concerns to the Senior Operations Manager in a timely manner. Requirements:  Previous experience in a field-based, data collection, survey, or inspection role is desirable but not essential. Strong attention to detail and accuracy when recording information. Good time management and organisational skills, with the ability to plan an efficient daily route. Comfortable using smartphones, tablets, or apps for data logging. Strong communication skills for interacting with site contacts and the public.  Must have a reliable personal vehicle and a valid driver's license for site visits. Must have a working smartphone. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, while keeping the Senior Operations Manager informed. Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to manage a varied daily schedule. jobs.description: Type: Full-time, salaried employment Sector: Retail and Retail Technology Location: NY/NJ. This role is primarily field-based, with approximately 75–100% of time spent visiting stores throughout the NY/NJ area. Occasional overnight stays may be required based on territory coverage and business needs. Salary Range: $120,000 to $150,000 On-Target-Earnings (80/20 split between base and bonus) + stock options   Who We Are Focal Systems is a pioneering Silicon Valley startup, leading the charge in retail AI solutions. We're on a mission to automate and optimize brick-and-mortar retail using cutting-edge deep learning computer vision.  We've already made a significant impact, with our solutions deployed at scale with some of the world's top retailers and we're expanding rapidly and looking for exceptional talent to join our journey within our North American Retail Consulting team.  We're searching for smart, creative, and passionate individuals who are eager to learn, enjoy critical thinking, share our core values, and are excited about building a great and enduring company with us. What We're Looking For We're seeking a results-driven Retail Consultant to join our Retail Consulting team on a full-time, permanent basis. In this critical role, you'll ensure our retail partners receive exceptional day-to-day support and achieve the maximum return on investment from their partnership with Focal and our technology solutions. You'll work closely with both new pilot projects and our established retail clients. This will involve owning the onboarding process and ongoing engagement with their stores, while also acting as the key link between the retailer and the wider Focal team. What You'll Be Doing In this role, you'll be at the forefront of ensuring our customers get the most out of Focal's solutions, ultimately boosting their success and satisfaction. You'll be a vital link between our customers and our product, driving adoption and demonstrating tangible value. Maximizing Customer Utilization You'll be instrumental in driving change management and adoption by providing an exceptional onboarding experience for Focal's customers. This means really getting to grips with their current and future operational processes, identifying any roadblocks, and actively removing barriers to utilization at every level of their organization. Your goal is to ensure our customers fully embrace and leverage the power of Focal. Increasing Customer Satisfaction You'll act as the voice and champion of the customer, proactively addressing any challenges they face and prioritizing their enhancement requests to directly influence Focal's product roadmap. Expect to travel to Focal enabled stores to strengthen customer engagement and adoption. You'll also facilitate internal collaboration across Focal's teams to ensure the best possible outcomes for our customers. Demonstrating Measurable ROI to the Customer You'll serve as a strategic advisor to our customers, helping them define, implement, and adopt best practices that align with their goals. A crucial part of your role will be to quantify the improvements that Focal's solutions bring to their store operations. You'll achieve this by constantly monitoring and analyzing their performance, then making proactive, data-driven recommendations that deliver clear, measurable results and help them achieve their desired outcomes.   What You'll Need to Be Successful To thrive in this role, you'll bring a blend of experience, skills, and a proactive mindset. Here's what we're looking for: Experience & Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. You possess mid or senior-level experience within the retail sector, ideally in grocery. This experience should preferably include involvement in digital transformation and/or process improvement initiatives.  Alternatively, you have 5+ years in a technology client-facing role, spanning areas such as customer success, account management, consulting, project management, change management, or onboarding / training. Skills & Attributes Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and listening skills are essential to connect with all stakeholders and build strong, trusting relationships. You demonstrate strategic thinking skills coupled with high intellectual curiosity, allowing you to delve deep into customer problems and align value back to their specific business objectives. You embody a start-up mindset and work ethic that aligns with our company core values. You have the ability, motivation, and energy to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, often unstructured environment, both independently and as part of a team. Additional Requirements You must have the ability to commute to stores as required. Why Focal Systems Joining Focal Systems means becoming part of a company that's truly making a difference in the retail world.
